nodes.label: Non-inflating operational evidence
nodes.summary: Evaluate operational claims through exact, typed, fresh evidence without allowing evaluation to create authority or effects.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Candidate product meaning is not a registered Product Capability, admitted ontology, or implementation claim.

nodes.label: Exact evaluation binding
nodes.summary: Every executable claim binds exact subjects, owners, artifacts, profiles, tools, observations, policies, expiry, invalidation, and supersession identities.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A structurally complete binding does not prove its sources authentic or its runtime observations true.

nodes.label: Evidence states remain distinct
nodes.summary: Passed, failed, missing, invalid, inconclusive, stale, and not-run outcomes are disjoint and aggregate only within an exact claim denominator.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Unknown, missing, stale, or unexecuted evidence cannot become pass by aggregation.

nodes.label: Failure meaning separation
nodes.summary: Domain failure meaning, integration outcome, and runtime exception mapping remain separate owned concepts.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A tool exception cannot redefine domain failure semantics or continuation ownership.

nodes.label: Product observability separation
nodes.summary: Product traces, metrics, logs, health, workload, and rollout observations remain distinct from workflow or agent telemetry.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Arcanum or orchestration telemetry is not product-runtime evidence.

nodes.label: Simulation is not deployment
nodes.summary: Simulation may test transition logic only and always remains deployment-effect false.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Simulation, replay, projection, tabletop evidence, or static configuration cannot satisfy actual-deployment evidence.

nodes.label: Missing data fails closed
nodes.summary: Missing observations, unknown policies, disabled thresholds, incomplete accounting, stale inputs, and unresolved owners cannot pass.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Absence of a finding or observation is not supporting evidence.

nodes.label: Observers do not actuate
nodes.summary: Observers may append evidence but cannot deploy, shift traffic, inject faults, roll back, admit, promote, or release.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An observation receipt grants no effect or successor authority.

nodes.label: Telemetry conservation
nodes.summary: Every offered observation is queued or rejected, and every queued observation is exported, dropped, or pending, with partial success explicit.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Telemetry presence does not prove completeness unless the full accounting closes.

nodes.label: Evidence-bound canary decision
nodes.summary: Compare exact stable and candidate cohorts under a bound policy and return pass, fail, or inconclusive without shifting traffic.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A canary-analysis result is not deployment authorization.

nodes.label: Independent rollback restoration
nodes.summary: Rollback is complete only when an independent observer verifies every declared candidate reference is absent before the deadline and stable identity remains unchanged.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Calling a rollback function or removing one container does not prove restoration.

nodes.label: Infrastructure plan safety
nodes.summary: Evaluate exact infrastructure-plan facts as clean, destructive, or unknown before any protected apply decision.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A clean static plan does not authorize apply or prove the runtime environment.

nodes.label: Evidence and effects have separate owners
nodes.summary: Planning, evaluation, observation, acceptance, admission, deployment, rollback, promotion, and release remain distinct owner-controlled states.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A passing check, accepted plan, or generated candidate cannot authorize commissioning or deployment.

nodes.label: Offline evidence contract family
nodes.summary: Closed candidate-local contracts for operational evidence, profiles, eligibility, derived controls, replay, and campaign composition.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Implemented offline contracts do not establish live source authenticity or runtime coverage.

nodes.label: Offline replay and campaign composer
nodes.summary: Deterministically replay individual tool evidence and compose two through seven items without aggregate control admission.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Recorded candidate-local tests are not current runtime evidence or source admission.

nodes.label: Body War runtime snapshot contract
nodes.summary: Closed snapshot and projection schemas bind compatibility, artifacts, timing, workload, telemetry, rollback, teardown, denied admission, and provenance.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Schema validity is not runtime observation, projection execution, or admission.

nodes.label: Runtime contract decoder
nodes.summary: Deterministically decode the runtime contract family and reject field, digest, compatibility, accounting, timing, admission, and authority forgery.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Decoder implementation is not a source projector, runtime observer, or accepted D65 realization.

nodes.label: Runtime snapshot projector
nodes.summary: Planned pure projector and CLI from exact runtime receipt input to denied-admission ORODI evidence.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A planned projector is not implemented and cannot convert runtime evidence into admitted evidence.

nodes.label: Canary lab contract family
nodes.summary: Planned configuration, gateway state, recovery ledger, decision receipt, evidence pack, provenance, and hostile-tabletop contracts.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Planned contract paths are not current files or validated implementation.

nodes.label: Stable-candidate canary gateway
nodes.summary: Planned deterministic 90/10 router with candidate-only pre-forward fault injection and explicit gateway state.
nodes.forbidden_inference: No gateway source, routing execution, fault execution, or network behavior currently exists.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry and Prometheus evidence pipeline
nodes.summary: Planned gateway instrumentation, metrics accounting, HTTP planes, and Prometheus-facing evaluation surface.
nodes.forbidden_inference: No live metrics, traces, logs, exporters, or monitoring coverage are observed.

nodes.label: Bounded workload and canary evaluator
nodes.summary: Planned bounded workload scheduler and exact threshold evaluator over complete stable and candidate observations.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Planned workload logic is not load execution or a canary verdict.

nodes.label: Recovery, rollback, and restoration controller
nodes.summary: Planned recovery ledger, ordered rollback, controller, and independent restoration observer.
nodes.forbidden_inference: No rollback was actuated and no restoration was observed.

nodes.label: Canonical evidence packager and projector
nodes.summary: Planned canonical, redacted, size-bounded evidence pack, projector, CLI, and tabletop evaluator.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Planned packaging does not establish source truth, admission, or effect authority.

nodes.label: Pinned local Compose lab
nodes.summary: Planned pinned four-container, one-network, zero-volume local lab with static validation.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Configuration design is not an image build, startup, network mutation, or commissioned environment.

nodes.label: ORODI validation and operations suite
nodes.summary: Planned aggregate test script, validation guide, operating guide, and separately gated commissioning handoff.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Documentation and a test entrypoint do not prove the tests passed or the lab can be commissioned.

nodes.label: Local canary commissioning runtime
nodes.summary: Future separately authorized local runtime for image preparation, startup, workload, fault, rollback, restoration observation, evidence retention, and teardown.
nodes.forbidden_inference: No commissioning authority, runtime state, Docker effect, network effect, or external effect exists.
